name: YanKer shop Food Co.,Ltd
summary: YanKer shop Food Co.,Ltd researches and develops, produces, and sells leisure food products in China and internationally. It offers deep-sea snacks, egg snacks, baked potatoes, bean products, candied roasted seeds and nuts, vegetarian food, meat and fish products, leisure snacks, and dried fruits. The company also provides baking, spicy strip, dried mango, fish tofu, and dry series products. In addition, it offers dried beans, potato chips, bread, cakes, and hot pepper products. It offers its products under the Kidney Beans 58 Fresh, Xiaoxin Prince, 12.5 Degrees Mango, 31 Degrees Fresh Fish, and Dry Series brands. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Changsha, China.
